template.boundary: Refine the implementation plan and dispatch sequence after R1 approval. Do not write tests or production code.
template.inputs: Ready requirements/use-case handoffs, R1 design review, impact summary, dependency report, project patterns.
template.forbidden: Approving own design, writing R1/R2/R3 reports, changing accepted scope, test edits, and production code edits.
template.outputs: Dispatch-ready exec plan evidence, open rework routing, service/code handoff assumptions.
template.done: TDD and implementation tasks have bounded inputs, ordered dependencies, and unresolved R1 findings are routed to rework.
